title: Platelet count–volume interaction does not improve cross-cycle prediction of C-reactive protein
abstract: In an exploratory NHANES 2007–2008 to 2009–2010 evaluation (4,850 source; 5,230 target adults), adding one platelet count–volume interaction to a flexible additive baseline changed weighted log-CRP MSE by 0.002019 (joint stratified PSU-bootstrap 95% interval -0.000706 to 0.011267). Incremental predictive benefit was not established.
